quote: The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) and IDB Invest are co-investing a combined $23 million in equity in micro-mobility platform Tembici... DFC’s investment totaled $15 million... expand Tembici’s electric bicycle assembly plant in Manaus (Brazil)
note: Opened DFC COP28 press release; DFC USD 15m equity; Manaus e-bike plant named.
